items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: His son is the terrific trumpet player we have today, Joe Newman, yeah.

ctx.x: Young Tuxedo, something like that, yeah. I remember the piano player was named Dwight Newman. His son is the terrific trumpet player we have today, Joe Newman, yeah.
And Lawrence would play a straight 4-4 even.
